It hadn't been that long since Mictlan asked about turning into a bird. The prospect hadn't been entirely attractive to them then, but now. 

Well, now. They look down at brown-furred legs tipped in hooves instead of snow-white feathers and eyes covering the back field of their vision. The sky is so *far away* now. It hadn't seemed so obvious when they still had wings, but. They miss it. 

Mictlan kind of wants to go home. But they know they can't- especially not now. They lie under a tree, unused to not being able to settle in a curl of wings and feathers on top instead, and take a long time to fall asleep, curled around their familiar.
